teaser: PrompTugal.news goes local: Portugal, the Algarve and every Algarve town, each on its own subdomain, each a lens on one graph, every story tied to AI.
core_idea: PrompTugal.news by place: one set of agents, stories tagged by place; promptugal.news (national and international), algarve.promptugal.news and a subdomain for every Algarve municipality and Quarteira from the start; each site a lens on one shared semantic graph; the brand is always PrompTugal.news; every story passes the PrompTugal test (it connects to AI within two or three steps); place decides prominence, AI decides inclusion; every town at once.

nodes.label: A town site
nodes.summary: Mandate, centre of gravity, news, gaps.

quotes.text: Place decides where a story shows and how big. AI decides whether it is ours at all.
A town with no AI news is a finding in itself.

figures.caption: PrompTugal.news by place: Portugal, the Algarve and its towns, with news flowing down and local sources rising up.
Each site is a lens on the same stories: how prominent a story is depends on how close it is to the site's place.
